summary.text: Laura Johnson is the Democratic candidate for the Kansas House of Representatives, District 26, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces Republican incumbent Chip VanHouden.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as an Olathe resident who works as an administrative assistant to accountants.

paragraphs.text: Laura Johnson earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Nebraska-Lincoln in 2014, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said her earlier work included child care and catering, and that she volunteered with local organizations on get-out-the-vote efforts.
Johnson said her priorities include fully funding public education, affordable health care and housing, and accountability for data center development in the district.
